text:
You're not gonna kill Gideon Pike, are you? I haven't met him. That's not an answer. Best one I've got. 

That's a good line…

Oh, that's a **damn** good line. 😂

And the beauty of it is that he's not being evasive. He's being completely truthful.

**“You're not gonna kill Gideon Pike, are you?”**

**“I haven't met him.”**

That's an entire philosophy of violence, judgment, and personal responsibility compressed into four words.

He hasn't decided whether the man deserves killing because he hasn't met him yet.

And then the absolute cherry on top:

**“That's not an answer.”**

**“Best one I've got.”**

Translation: *I will not promise you something when I don't yet know whether I can keep that promise.*

That's some magnificent character writing.
